question: A father is three times as old as his son. After 12 years from now, he will be twice as old as his son. Find the present ages (in years) of the father and the son, respectively.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let son = x ⇒ father = 3x

After 12 years: 3x + 12 = 2(x + 12)

⇒ 3x + 12 = 2x + 24

⇒ x = 12

**∴ Answer = Father = 36 years, Son = 12 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Father is 3 times son. After 12 years, father is twice son.

**Formula used:**

Linear equation based on age relations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let son age = S, father age = F

⇒ F = 3S

⇒ After 12 years: F + 12 = 2(S + 12)

⇒ Substitute F: 3S + 12 = 2S + 24

⇒ S = 12

⇒ F = 3 × 12 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is Father = 36 years, Son = 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equation Concept

Use variables to represent present ages and form equations based on conditions.

Future Age Relation

After n years: add n to both present ages before forming relation.

Ratio Concept

If one age is k times another ⇒ express as multiplication.

Linear Equation Solving

Simplify equation step by step to isolate variable.
